item.title: Las Vegas military veteran, 70, embroiled in dispute over 1 mortgage payment
item.description: An elderly Marine veteran said a mortgage payment was deducted from his checking account but never acknowledged by his lender, which resulted in a months-long dispute, thousands of dollars in arrearages and putting his credit into a spiraling freefall.

item.title: Star Map, winged statues a welcome sight at Hoover Dam after prolonged restoration
item.description: Monument Plaza at Hoover Dam has reopened, restoring access to artwork created in the 1930s and visited by millions of visitors over the past nine decades.

item.description: As a cold snap made its way to Southern Nevada, showers continue to slide through the region with primarily light rain.

item.title: SafeNest Highlights hidden dangers of teen dating violence, strangulation
item.description: The dangers facing teens in 2026 are endless, especially in dating. The FBI's 2024 special report on teen relationship violence, released this month, paints a disturbing picture.

item.title: Double shooting in Pahrump; suspect in custody
item.description: The Nye County Sheriff's Office is investigating a double shooting in Pahrump that stemmed from a domestic incident, with one suspect in custody and no threat to the community.
